scope: Nine exact preexisting RUF020 fixture mismatches. No source body is changed, no parser error is suppressed, and no shared binding helper is modified.
shadow_contract: An actual PEP695 type parameter is distinct from typing.Never, typing.Union or the typing module, even if the spellings coincide. An arbitrary type parameter is not the bottom type. A type-variable subscript or attribute does not become typing.Union or typing.Never.
scope_policy: The ninth case intentionally follows lexical static-typing bindings for the local typing.Never import. PEP563 distinguishes static analysis from runtime resolution. CPython default get_type_hints resolves module str|int in a compatible reproducer; explicit enclosing localns resolves typing.Never|int. Both are retained. This exact certificate is a documented static-typing scope-policy difference, not a claim that Ruff has a runtime semantic bug or that the fix preserves every runtime introspection result.
version_contract: Canonical parser target3.10 does not support PEP695 declaration headers; their existing invalid-syntax diagnostics remain unchanged. Actual CPython3.13.5 controls establish type-parameter namespace identities for the feature introduced3.12, not original3.10 execution. Separate CPython3.10.19 controls replace unavailable typing.Never (3.11+) by equivalent typing.NoReturn as Never and explicitly label changed compatible sources.

primary_basis.basis: New type parameter syntax creates a distinct lexical scope; names are not resolved to same-spelled module imports.
Type parameter namespaces participate in forward-reference evaluation.
Postponed evaluation changes runtime annotation access while static type checking remains unchanged.
Module globals and supplied locals affect runtime resolution; enclosing function state is not generally recovered automatically.

independent_controls: Nine actual CPython3.13 checks distinguish the TypeVar object by identity, retain live unrelated-generic typing.Never positives, and expose both scope-policy outcomes; two actual3.10 compatible controls preserve that namespace distinction. All exact pinned reference JSON and source inputs are retained.
